title: Text: Kristie Ackert ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Well, we go to my grandmothers for Christmas Eve. My parents are there. Then we come home and have Christmas Day with Shaun’s dad. Traditional Irish breakfast and then we have some friends coming over
searchText: well, we go to my grandmothers for christmas eve. my parents are there. then we come home and have christmas day with shaun’s dad. traditional irish breakfast and then we have some friends coming over for drinks after dinner. very low key. you? kristie ackert
